headline: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
context: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.
